package.name: rm65_dual_arm
package.description: RM65 dual-arm ROS 2 node (C++ SDK, single node, two handles). Publishes left/right RM65 TCP pose and hardware health to ACT, and executes ACT left/right end-effector target poses when the human permit is valid. A delta guard clamps every command to a tiny step relative to the current TCP to prevent large-range motion during testing.
